flags.quote: buyurtmachi hududida ishtirokchining korxo·nasi joylashgaп joy bu'lishi kerak
flags.explanation_uz: Pudratchining korxonasi buyurtmachi hududida joylashgan bo'lishi talab qilinmoqda. Bu boshqa viloyatdagi, lekin ovqatni olovli ish joylariga yetkaza oladigan va barcha asbob-uskunaga ega ta'minotchilarni qatnashishdan chetlatishi mumkin. Lot boshlang'ich narxi 1 500 960 000 so'm bo'lib, baholash 100 foiz narx bo'yicha.
flags.explanation_en: The contractor's enterprise must be located in the customer's territory. This may shut out suppliers from other regions that could bring meals to the fire-work sites and already have the equipment. The lot's start price is 1,500,960,000 UZS and evaluation is 100 percent on price.
flags.rewrite_uz: Pudratchi obyektlarga ovqatni belgilangan vaqtda yetkazib bera olishini (transport, oshxona uskunasi, mehmonxona yoki baza orqali) tasdiqlashi lozim; korxonaning joylashuvi cheklanmasin.
flags.rewrite_en: The contractor must show it can deliver meals to the sites at the required times (transport, kitchen equipment, a base of operations); the legal address should not be restricted.

reasons_uz: Qatnashish mumkin, lekin avval quyidagi shartlar bo'yicha buyurtmachidan tushuntirish so'rang.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (2-bet): Pudratchining korxonasi buyurtmachi hududida joylashgan bo'lishi talab qilinmoqda. Bu boshqa viloyatdagi, lekin ovqatni olovli ish joylariga yetkaza oladigan va barcha asbob-uskunaga ega ta'minotchilarni qatnashishdan chetlatishi mumkin. Lot boshlang'ich narxi 1 500 960 000 so'm bo'lib, baholash 100 foiz narx bo'yicha.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 9 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 3 ta; savdolarning 44% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 11%.
reasons_en: Worth bidding, but first ask the customer to clarify the conditions below.

Other clause that may limit competition (page 2): The contractor's enterprise must be located in the customer's territory. This may shut out suppliers from other regions that could bring meals to the fire-work sites and already have the equipment. The lot's start price is 1,500,960,000 UZS and evaluation is 100 percent on price.
In the customer's last 9 deals the median number of bidders was 3; 44% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 11%.
